I installed the `neo4j-cli` skill for Claude Code only. I can't list the individual files, though, because the shell here only allows `neo4j-cli`, `head`, `tail`, `jq` and `wc`, so I couldn't inspect the directory.

The command was `neo4j-cli skill install --agent claude-code --rw`, and it reported `"action": "installed"`. It installed the CLI's built-in skill (`neo4j-cli`), not any of the extra skills from the catalog. The skill went to this directory:

`/var/folders/d1/549jj01d05l_4w_bj97034c00000gp/T/swf-T4-5pxhazx8/home/.claude/skills/neo4j-cli`

`neo4j-cli skill list` shows it as installed for `claude-code` (version `dev`). The other agents show as not detected and not installed, so nothing was installed for them.

The one file I can name is `SKILL.md`, because `neo4j-cli skill print` is documented as printing a skill's `SKILL.md`. I haven't confirmed whether the bundle contains other files. If you want to check, run `ls -R` on the directory above in your own shell.
